description: Schema + seed rows, then requests under a fixed clock and server-id sequence -> per-step result or error, then every table's final rows.

vectors.name: insert with a server id [columns]
vectors.why: no client id: the server draws one

vectors.name: insert with a client id [columns]
vectors.why: the client's UUIDv7 is the _id

vectors.name: insert with a taken client id [columns]
vectors.why: an insert implies expect exists:false: ConflictError, not a storage error

vectors.name: one clock reading per request [columns]
vectors.why: every insert in a request shares _creationTime; server ids are drawn in op order

vectors.name: same client id twice in one request [columns]
vectors.why: the second insert sees the first

vectors.name: insert into an unknown table [columns]
vectors.why: CompileError, op index set

vectors.name: insert with _id in the body [columns]
vectors.why: server-owned fields are not body fields

vectors.name: insert with U+0000 [columns]
vectors.why: text storage contract

vectors.name: insert at the integer bounds [columns]
vectors.why: 2^53-1 stores and reads back exactly; gt sees it

vectors.name: number beyond 2^53 [columns]
vectors.why: an integral double above 2^53 round-trips and matches eq in both layouts (item 30)

vectors.name: get existing and missing [columns]
vectors.why: a document or null

vectors.name: select all [columns]
vectors.why: ordered by _id

vectors.name: order ties break on _id [columns]
vectors.why: n2 and n3 share rank 2: _id ASC decides

vectors.name: nulls first ascending [columns]
vectors.why: NULLS FIRST on asc

vectors.name: nulls last descending [columns]
vectors.why: NULLS LAST on desc

vectors.name: order by number [columns]
vectors.why: numbers order numerically in both layouts

vectors.name: limit [columns]
vectors.why: limit cuts after ordering

vectors.name: eq boolean [columns]
vectors.why: booleans compare as 0/1 in both layouts

vectors.name: eq null [columns]
vectors.why: IS NULL

vectors.name: gt number [columns]
vectors.why: score > 0

vectors.name: count [columns]
vectors.why: all matching rows, no limit

vectors.name: countBy [columns]
vectors.why: groups ordered by value, null first

vectors.name: countBy limit [columns]
vectors.why: limit caps groups

vectors.name: select limit 0 [columns]
vectors.why: CompileError invalid-limit at execution

vectors.name: gt on a string [columns]
vectors.why: CompileError gt-requires-numeric

vectors.name: filter value U+0000 [columns]
vectors.why: a NUL never reaches SQLite, even as a filter

vectors.name: query ignores requestId [columns]
vectors.why: reads are never deduplicated

vectors.name: patch [columns]
vectors.why: partial merge; result is the new _version; _creationTime unchanged

vectors.name: empty patch [columns]
vectors.why: still bumps _version

vectors.name: patch missing [columns]
vectors.why: NotFoundError 404

vectors.name: patch invalid value [columns]
vectors.why: validated with partial = true

vectors.name: patch expect version pass [columns]
vectors.why: version equal

vectors.name: patch expect version fail [columns]
vectors.why: ConflictError with both versions

vectors.name: patch expect version on missing [columns]
vectors.why: version implies existence: exists check fails first

vectors.name: patch expect fields pass [columns]
vectors.why: scalar equality

vectors.name: patch expect fields fail [columns]
vectors.why: reports the expected and the actual values of the named fields

vectors.name: expect fields unknown field [columns]
vectors.why: CompileError unknown-field

vectors.name: expect fields metadata [columns]
vectors.why: _version is checked with expect.version, not fields

vectors.name: expect fields array [columns]
vectors.why: arrays are not comparable

vectors.name: expect fields wrong type [columns]
vectors.why: values are validated against the node

vectors.name: delete existing [columns]
vectors.why: {deleted: true}

vectors.name: delete missing [columns]
vectors.why: not an error: {deleted: false}

vectors.name: delete missing that must exist [columns]
vectors.why: expect exists:true turns it into a conflict

vectors.name: delete with version [columns]
vectors.why: guarded delete

vectors.name: assert pass [columns]
vectors.why: result null, no write

vectors.name: assert absence pass [columns]
vectors.why: exists:false on a missing document

vectors.name: assert absence fail [columns]
vectors.why: exists:false on a present document

vectors.name: assert unknown table [columns]
vectors.why: the table is looked up first

vectors.name: $ref chain [columns]
vectors.why: insert a list, insert its entry by reference, read both back

vectors.name: $ref as a patch and assert id [columns]
vectors.why: ids resolve in every id position

vectors.name: selects see earlier writes [columns]
vectors.why: ops run in order in one transaction

vectors.name: delete then reinsert the same id [columns]
vectors.why: a delete frees the id for a later insert in the same request

vectors.name: failed mutation leaves no trace [columns]
vectors.why: a late failure rolls back earlier ops and the request id; a retry with the same id applies

vectors.name: failed precondition after a write [columns]
vectors.why: preconditions anywhere in the list guard the whole request

vectors.name: duplicate request id [columns]
vectors.why: answers the first result with duplicate:true and runs nothing, even with a different payload

vectors.name: duplicate of a read-only mutation [columns]
vectors.why: a mutation of only reads is still recorded and answered from the record

vectors.name: duplicate whose new payload is invalid [columns]
vectors.why: a duplicate's operations are decoded but never validated: an unknown table still gets the first answer

vectors.name: expect fields wrong type on a missing document [columns]
vectors.why: expect.fields values are validated before existence is checked

vectors.name: invalid patch body on a missing document [columns]
vectors.why: the body is validated before the document is loaded: SchemaError, not NotFoundError

vectors.name: version and fields both failing [columns]
vectors.why: checks run exists, version, fields: version is reported

vectors.name: schema fingerprint mismatch [columns]
vectors.why: SchemaDriftError 409, no op index, nothing runs

vectors.name: sdk: createGame [columns]
vectors.why: the SDK's commit for createGame: one insert with a client UUIDv7, no reads, no asserts

vectors.name: sdk: makeMove [columns]
vectors.why: makeMove's get is a query; the commit asserts the version it read, patches, inserts the move

vectors.name: sdk: makeMove after a concurrent write conflicts at the derived assert [columns]
vectors.why: the game changed between the SDK's read and its commit: ConflictError at op 0 (derived), nothing applied

vectors.name: sdk: deleteGame [columns]
vectors.why: deleteGame reads the game (asserted) and its moves (a select: unguarded), then deletes them
